title: Police Blotter: 13 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 13 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and a federal hold on Nov. 6–7, 2026 — including alleged assault of a family member, DWI, marijuana possession, and a federal violation hold. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Thirteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and a federal hold on Friday and Saturday, November 6 and 7, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

POLENDO, CLAUDIA YVETTE

POLENDO, CLAUDIA YVETTE was arrested on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 7:42 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of violating a bond or protective order, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

FARIAS, VICTOR MANUEL

FARIAS, VICTOR MANUEL was arrested on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 10:46 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor (three counts), and possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set on any charge at the time of booking.

LARA, IVAN LYNN

LARA, IVAN LYNN was arrested on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 10:52 p.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

FUENTES, CARLOS ALEJANDRO

FUENTES, CARLOS ALEJANDRO was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 3:22 a.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,500 as a personal recognizance bond.

GARZA, RAUL, JR

GARZA, RAUL, JR was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 3:22 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000.

GARCIA, EDGAR ISMAEL

GARCIA, EDGAR ISMAEL was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 3:47 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

GONZALEZ, JESSI

GONZALEZ, JESSI was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 4:54 a.m. by the United States Marshals on an alleged charge of a federal violation. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. She is held by United States Marshals.

SANCHEZ, ERICK ANTHONY

SANCHEZ, ERICK ANTHONY was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 5:04 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $15,000.

CHAVEZ, GERARDO

CHAVEZ, GERARDO was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 7:24 a.m. on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

PALACIOS, MAYRA

PALACIOS, MAYRA was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 2:36 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of resisting arrest, search, or transport, a Class A misdemeanor, and failure to identify, giving false or fictitious information, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000 on the resisting charge and $500 on the failure-to-identify charge.

PENA, LEONARDO, JR

PENA, LEONARDO, JR was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 5:43 p.m. on an alleged charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

MORENO, OSCAR

MORENO, OSCAR was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 6:52 p.m. on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

AMESQUITA, RYAN ISAAC

AMESQUITA, RYAN ISAAC was arrested on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 7:44 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000.
